literal: Having understood the true support, if one conducts oneself so that worldly attachments perish, then the afflicting sufferings that usually attach will be destroyed and will not attach again.
translation: If one realizes the true support of all and lives so that worldly attachments perish, the afflictions that normally cling to life will be destroyed and will never cling again.
modern: உண்மையான பற்றை உணர்ந்து, உலகப் பற்றுகள் அழியுமாறு வாழ்ந்தால், தொடர்ந்து வந்து பற்றுகின்ற பிறவித்துன்பங்கள் அழிந்து மீண்டும் வந்து பற்ற மாட்டா.
explanation: This couplet uses the word 'சார்பு' in two different senses to guide the seeker. The first 'சார்பு' refers to the ultimate reality or true support of existence, which one must realize. The second 'சார்பு' refers to worldly attachments and dependencies that must be destroyed. When a person lives with this realization, the 'சார்தரு நோய்'—the recurring sufferings of birth and rebirth that naturally cling to human life—are completely destroyed and will never return.
